parsed.observations: Leaf blade has numerous small, round to oval orange-brown pustules scattered across its surface, with surrounding yellowing and a pale tan necrotic area containing dark specks near the right end. Pustules do not form stripes; no white powdery growth is visible.
parsed.summary: Leaf rust is strongly supported by numerous scattered orange-brown pustules on the leaf blade; the necrotic area and dark specks do not clearly establish an additional disease.
